title: Smoky Chickpea Stew
description: Warming vegetarian chickpea and potato stew in a smoky paprika and tomato broth with carrots and celery.

ingredients.text: 2 carrots, peeled and cut into 5mm (¼in)-thick slices
1.3 litres vegetable stock (1 vegetable stock cube dissolved in 1.3 litres boiling water) (use
500g potatoes, peeled and cut into 2.5cm (1in) dice
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
small handful of fresh flat-leaf parsley, chopped

steps: Spray a saucepan with low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the onions, carrots and celery and sauté for 8–10 minutes, then add the smoked paprika and garlic and cook for a further minute to release the aromas.
Stir in the tomato puree, then add the 1.3 litres of stock, red wine stock pot and bay leaves.
Bring to the boil, cover, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes, chickpeas and red wine vinegar and cook for a further 50 minutes–1 hour, uncovered, until the vegetables are soft and the sauce is thick.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, remove the bay leaves and serve sprinkled with chopped parsley.
SLOW-COOKER METHOD   HIGH: ABOUT 4 HOURS LOW: 7–8 HOURS

Put all the ingredients (600ml stock), except the parsley, into the slow- cooker bowl and stir well. It might look as if there is not enough liquid, but don’t worry, the vegetables will release liquid as they cook, producing a rich sauce.
Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 7–8 hours.
Remove the bay leaves, stir, season with salt and pepper and serve sprinkled with the chopped parsley.
